title: Free RPG Maker VX Ace for Free or RPG Maker MZ for $35 Valentine's Day?

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
I saw a video informing that
RPG Maker VX Ace was free
and
MZ was on sale for about $35
. I remember seeing a Pokemon mod and also a Chrono Trigger hack to propose to their girlfriend and thought they were cute, but I can't find the original videos. Since there is about 10 days until then, this might give someone time to give or make a nice Valentine's Day gift.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Is there a reason to use XP outside of making Pokemon fangames? It's also $.50 cheaper on Steam when it's on sale (like right now).
It's ok to want free, it's a large part of why Godot has such a massive userbase, but raising a fuss over saving a few bucks on RPG Maker is pretty hilarious.
